Here's how to turn off Rock Band 4's Freestyle guitar solos

Freestyle solos is a feature that turns off the original solos from popular songs and instead replaces them with a nearly blank slate for you to jam out with your own free-form solo. It's a handy feature for players who can comfortably play through a song but get thrown by more complex scripted solos. I ended up looking up how to turn it off because I missed some of the iconic solos like the one in "No One Like You" by the Scorpions. I'm glad they decided to make it an optional feature.
